concerns.text: FR-005 mandates Mann‑Whitney U and Kolmogorov‑Smirnov tests as secondary analyses, but T008 only runs Wilcoxon signed‑rank tests, omitting the required Mann‑Whitney U and KS tests, thus weakening the functional requirement.
SC-002 requires a KS test on severity‑score distributions; T008’s verification does not include any KS test, leaving the success‑criteria uncovered.

SC-006 specifies at least 50 valid paired problem entries per LLM model. The current tasks verify only a total of 50 human problems and do not ensure each model attains the 50‑pair threshold after generation failures, weakening the success criterion.

SC-003 defines an effect‑size threshold (|Cliff’s Δ| > 0.14). T008’s verification merely records the effect size without checking whether it meets the threshold, thus not satisfying the success‑criteria.
T003’s verification cites “pair‑integrity rate ≥ 95 % (SC‑005)” but the intended metric belongs to SC‑006; the reference should be corrected to avoid confusion.
